description: This file defines template classes and functions related to command source generation and management within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes class templates for creating command sources, handling different return types, and integrating with dependency injection via the 'fruit' library. The file also declares a utility alias for creating command instances.

classes.name: GenericCommandSource
classes.description: A template class that creates command sources with various return types, supporting dependency injection and command execution logic.

classes.name: GenericCommandImpl
classes.description: A template struct that provides a static method to generate a dependency injection component for command sources based on function signatures.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Initializes and sets up commands based on the provided function and return type.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the command source, derived from the function name.

methods.name: Dependencies
methods.description: Returns the set of setup features that this command source depends on.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Returns the list of commands generated by this source.

methods.name: Component
methods.description: Creates a dependency injection component for the command source, conditionally including kernel log pipe consumer binding.
